text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russian official says Moscow committed to the lifting of sanctions on Iraq.
- An exhibition for Arab food and pharmaceutical industries to be held in Baghdad on Monday.
- U.S. studies lifting of sanctions on China.
- Iraqi computer scientists hope to be able to have access to Internet.
- International organisations demand immediate implementation of Iraq's oil-for-food deal with the United Nations.
(The above were also carried by AL-THAWRA and QADISSIYA)
